steps.caption: The Pipeline
steps.narration: A lead is a job you haven't won yet. Here's how to add one in the ConstructHUB CRM.

steps.caption: New lead
steps.narration: On the Pipeline, choose New lead.

steps.caption: Lead name
steps.narration: Give the lead a name that says who it is and what the job is.

steps.caption: Existing client
steps.narration: If this person is already a client, choose Existing client and search for them.

steps.caption: Client name
steps.narration: For someone new, type their name. The CRM adds them to your clients.

steps.caption: Estimated value
steps.narration: Estimated value is optional. Type a rough number if you have one.

steps.caption: In the Lead column
steps.narration: The lead lands in the first stage, Lead, with its value.

steps.caption: New leads
steps.narration: Under Needs attention, it's listed with your new leads,

steps.caption: Needs an estimate
steps.narration: and under Needs an estimate, until you write one.

steps.caption: Menu: Pipeline
steps.narration: You'll find New lead on the Pipeline, in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to add a lead | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of adding a lead in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will name the lead, choose a new or an existing client, add an estimated value, and see where the lead shows up on the Pipeline and on Home.
